name: research-offload
description: MCP server that runs web search and research OFF a filtered machine and returns the answer. Mounted by presets/yocheved/ only.
_dshNote: This package deliberately declares NO dsh.bundle.patch, so harness-sync links it but does NOT name it in dsh.profile.bundles. Naming it would mount it as a patch layer and stop the engine booting (dsh-app-boot:852) -- that failure mode is why scripts/harness-sync.mjs has a declaresBundle guard. It is meant to be started as an MCP stdio child by the preset row, not mounted.
